prompt:
Square premium painterly naturalistic folklore artwork of one adult Adlet, choosing documented Inuit mythic hybrid form: HUMAN upper body and DOG lower body. Fully HUMAN head, face, shoulders, two arms and hands; below waist canine fur, two dog hind legs with natural hocks and paws and one dog tail. No dog head or human feet, no horns,wings,extra limbs. Simple opaque warm tunic covering torso and hips, canine legs and tail clearly visible; clothes and dark-grey fur are editorial choices. He stands alone on windswept rocky Hudson Bay shore, tense wary expression and ready stance convey dangerous presence through ordinary pose, not ethnicity. Tall athletic build rather than colossal scale. Natural cold daylight, distant bay, rich painterly oil detail. No victims, gore, aura,glowing eyes,neon energy,luminous mist,text or border.

Final anatomy must be exactly TWO canine hind legs with paws below his waist: retain the left paw at image-left and main nearer central paw, remove the rightmost rear paw and whole attached leg. No other changes, no extra limbs.
